# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: headline metrics

As of 2026-09-30.

## Who is told what

| Indicator | Network board | Members | Funders | County planning office |
|-----------|---|---|---|---|
| Leadership practice maturity | 1 | 2 | 4 |  |
| Back-office share of operating budget | 2 |  | 3 |  |
| Joint positions adopted by members | 3 |  |  | 1 |
| Member organizations reached across the whole network | 4 | 3 | 2 |  |
| Stories of members helping each other |  | 1 |  |  |
| Residents served by member organizations |  |  | 1 |  |

A number is the place the indicator takes in that audience's list.

## Network board

| Number | Latest | Status | How to describe it |
|--------|--------|--------|--------------------|
| Leadership practice across members | Emerging (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |
| Back-office share of members' budgets | 20.8 percent (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |
| Joint positions adopted | 2 positions (on 2026-09-30) | On track | attributable to the work |
| Member organizations reached across the whole network | 84 member organizations (on 2026-09-30) | On track | attributable to the work |

Notes on these numbers:

- Leadership practice across members: The learning program's North Star.
- Leadership practice across members: The first cohort has not yet reached its twelve-month rating.
- Back-office share of members' budgets: The shared services program's North Star.
- Joint positions adopted: The civic voice program's North Star.
- Member organizations reached across the whole network: Less than the 131 that the program-area counts add up to, because 47 members take part in more than one program area.

Caveats that go with these numbers:

- Rated by coaches and members, so it reflects self-assessment as well as observed practice.
- Self-reported by members; other cost changes can also move the figure.
- Not equal to the sum of the program-area counts, which double count members in more than one program.

## Funders

| Number | Latest | Status | How to describe it |
|--------|--------|--------|--------------------|
| Residents served by members | 62000 residents (estimate, on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |
| Member organizations the network reached | 84 member organizations (on 2026-09-30) | On track | attributable to the work |
| Back-office share of operating budget | 20.8 percent (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |
| Leadership practice maturity | Emerging (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |

Notes on these numbers:

- Residents served by members: Reported as a contribution; members serve them, the network does not.
- Residents served by members: Partial-year estimate from 61 responding members.
- Member organizations the network reached: Less than the 131 that the program-area counts add up to, because 47 members take part in more than one program area.
- Leadership practice maturity: The first cohort has not yet reached its twelve-month rating.

Caveats that go with these numbers:

- Reflects members' reported reach; Riverbend Nonprofit Network cannot attribute resident outcomes to its own work.
- Residents who use several members are counted more than once.
- Not equal to the sum of the program-area counts, which double count members in more than one program.
- Self-reported by members; other cost changes can also move the figure.
- Rated by coaches and members, so it reflects self-assessment as well as observed practice.
